To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the lignin of bamboo pretreated with sodium hydroxide solution at low temperature is mainly composed of guaiacyl and syringyl units.
the structure of lignin extracted from the bamboo (Neosinalamus affinis) pretreated with cold sodium hydroxide solution is mainly composed of β-O-4 ether linkages, phenylcoumarane and resinol.
the structure of bamboo lignin is mainly composed of H/G/S lignins, which are mainly linked through the β-O-4 ether bonds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of the isolated lignins of pretreated bamboo.
the extraction and characterization of lignin from bamboo pretreated with a cold alkaline solution at low temperatures.
the isolation of lignin from bamboo pretreated with sodium hydroxide solution at low temperature, and the structure of the isolated product was characterized.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the lignin isolated from bamboo pretreated with cold alkaline/urea solution was a complex mixture of H, G and S units, which contained more β-O-4 ether linkages than those of the original lignin.
the isolated lignin from bamboo is a complex mixture of lignin units with a high proportion of β-O-4 ether linkages.
lignin from ball-milled bamboo pretreated with sodium hydroxide-urea solution at low temperature was mainly composed of β-O-4 ether linkages with a high proportion of S-type lignin.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the isolated bamboo lignin could be used as a potential source of bio-based materials for various applications.
bamboo is a potential raw material for the production of lignin, and the cold alkali pretreatment is a promising method to extract lignin from biomass.
the lignin isolated from the bamboo pretreated under ultrasound in ethanol solution at low temperature was a mixture of lignins, and the structure was changed by the alkaline pretreatment.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the lignin isolated from bamboo pretreated at low temperature is similar to the lignin from bamboo pretreated with NaOH/urea solution at 100 oC, but with less condensation of lignin and a lower content of ester bonds.
the structure of the extracted lignin was greatly affected by the ultrasound treatment and the cold alkaline pretreatment.
the structure of lignin extracted from ball-milled bamboo pretreated with cold NaOH/urea solution is similar to the structure of native lignin.
